name: GoldenPad

inputs.description: Your own US retail GoldenEye 007 ROM (normalized SHA-1 abe01e4aeb033b6c0836819f549c791b26cfde83). The primary build converts it privately and translates it with N64Recomp; the app also imports it on first launch.

tools.name: cmake
tools.note: Install CMake 3.28 or newer: brew install cmake

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.note: Install full Xcode and its iOS platform, then select that Xcode in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; Command Line Tools alone are not enough.

tools.name: xcrun
tools.label: Xcode iPhoneOS SDK
tools.note: Install full Xcode and its iOS platform, then select that Xcode in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; Command Line Tools alone are not enough.

tools.name: xcrun
tools.label: Xcode iPhoneSimulator SDK
tools.note: Install full Xcode and its iOS platform, then select that Xcode in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; GoldenPad's RT64 build also needs the iPhoneSimulator SDK.

tools.name: xcrun
tools.label: Metal Toolchain
tools.note: Install Xcode's Metal Toolchain: xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain

tools.name: %ProgramFiles(x86)%/Microsoft Visual Studio/Installer/vswhere.exe
tools.label: Visual Studio C++ Build Tools
tools.note: Install Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools with Desktop development with C++ and a Windows SDK. On Windows ARM64, add the ARM64 C++ tools (preferred) or the x64/x86 C++ tools.

tools.name: %ProgramFiles(x86)%/Microsoft Visual Studio/Installer/vswhere.exe
tools.label: Visual Studio C++ Build Tools
tools.note: Install Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools with Desktop development with C++, x64/x86 C++ tools and a Windows SDK.

tools.name: c++
tools.label: C++ compiler
tools.note: Install a C++ compiler and its standard library first: sudo apt install build-essential (Debian, Ubuntu, Chromebook Linux) or sudo dnf install gcc-c++ (Fedora).

notes: scripts/build-personal-ipa.sh chains scripts/bootstrap-sources.sh, TLB-free conversion with the pinned fork's vanilla_to_tlbfree.xdelta (identical to upstream a787fe0), scripts/generate-recomp-inputs.sh, runtime and RT64 archive builds, scripts/build-recomp-apple.sh ios and the existing package checks. See docs/BUILDING.md. Windows: Next-release experimental module route. Requires a matching empty shell supplied with --app until an audited shell release exists. The static Mac route remains scripts/build-personal-ipa.sh. See docs/WINDOWS_MODULE.md for evidence and remaining gates.

publication.reason: Personal apps and modules contain game code and conversion data derived from the player-owned ROM. The repository release pause still applies; publish source only.
